description: 100% Pure Beeswax Pillar Candles from the Mohawk Valley Trading Company are hand poured and made from 100% all natural, unbleached yellow beeswax, produced by bees in the USA. There are many benefits to choosing beeswax over paraffin (a sludge and waste product from the refining of petroleum) candles. Beeswax candles burn clean; unlike paraffin they do not contain any additives or synthetic chemicals. Cheap paraffin candles leave behind black soot from smoke as they are burned. The soot can damage furniture and irritate sensitive people. If the wick is the wrong size, wrong type or off center the candle will burn unevenly and liquid wax will drip and pool around the candle, potentially damaging its surroundings or even causing burns. When burned correctly, with a trimmed wick and in a draft free zone beeswax candles are smoke free, soot free and drip free. When burned they emit negative ions, thought by some to clean the air and prevent problems with asthma and depression. The higher cost of beeswax candles can be off-putting but a much longer burn time makes them a more economical choice than paraffin. Beeswax candles also burn brighter. They are often available without any added chemical scents or colors. This makes them ideal for people with chemical sensitivities or allergies. Beeswax itself has a subtly honey or floral scent even when it is not burning. The color of the wax ranges from pale buttery yellow to deep golden yellow based on the pollen used by the bees to produce the honey and wax.

Organic Coconut Wax Candles

Coconut wax is made out of raw and natural product - the coconut. The process involves gathering the coconut meat and cold pressing its oil. Coconut is organic, sustainable and eco-friendly. It is considered by many as the best wax used in candles.

Paddywax는 장식부터 선물, 방종에 이르기까지 모든 양초를 만족시키는 다양한 캔들 컬렉션을 자랑하며, 실제로 어떤 양초가 무엇인지 아닌가요? 패디 왁스 캔들을 만드는 과정은 모든 의미에서 장인이며 수백 년 전에 양초를 만드는 데 사용되는 기술과 비슷합니다. 향기부터 연소 시간까지, 각 맞춤형 레시피는 최고의 경험을 제공하기 위해 만들어졌습니다. 당사의 향기 혼합물은 모든 천연 재료를 사용하여 가장 자연스러운 향기를 분배하기 위해 개발되었습니다. 저희는 절대 합성 향료를 제공하지 않는 것에 자부심을 가지고 있습니다. 대신 자연스럽고 독특한 것을 만들기 위해 끊임없이 노력합니다. 모든 양초를 손으로 부을 때 시작하여 각 제품이 정밀하게 포장될 때 끝납니다. 각 리본과 라벨은 모든 제품에 사람의 손길을 전달하기 위해 손으로 부착되어 있습니다. 우리는 우리의 일에 자부심을 가지고 모든 세부 사항이 중요하다는 것을 알고 있습니다.

description: The Advent wreath is the traditional centerpiece of the Christmas season. It symbolizes the passage of the four weeks of Advent in the liturgical calendar of the Western Church. Advent begins on the fourth Sunday before Christmas Day. On the First Sunday of Advent, a purple (or blue) candle is lit to celebrate Hope, the inspiring and uplifting hope that Christ among us represents. On the Second Sunday of Advent, another purple (or blue) candle is lit to celebrate Peace, both the Prince of Peace himself and the promise of peace on Earth. On the Third Sunday of Advent, a pink candle is lit to celebrate Joy, the joy the shepherds received at hearing the news of Christ's birth, or the joy that God brings into our lives. As the coming of Christ draws near, the final purple (or blue) candle is lit on the Fourth Sunday of Advent to celebrate Love, both God's boundless love for us and our love for one another. The bright light from the candles is an expression of the growing anticipation of the birth of Jesus Christ, who in Christian faith is seen as the Light of the World. description:
We offer the engineered plastic candle molds. They are suitable for filling with wax, paraffin and other bases. The material is very much resistant to high and low temperatures (up to 85-90°С / 185-194 °F), that’s why the candle molds do not crack or break down in service. Plastic can be in contact with paraffin.

The molds are divided into a body and a lid to take a candle out comfortably. We recommend greasing the candle mold with silicone or oil before filling it with wax, in order to be able to take the candle out more easily. There is a hole in the center of the lid to pull a wick through. Use boiled water to clean the carved candle mold after taking the candle out. Make sure the candle mold is properly cleaned and free of wax before reusing it. If the mold is not completely cleaned, this might create difficulties for extracting the candle you are going to make next. Follow these instructions to avoid issues with pouring the candles.

The lower the temperature, the higher the chances of candle’s surface to get matte are. The higher the temperature of the filling, the smoother the surface will get. But it is necessary to remember that the higher temperature of paraffin, the more difficult it will be to take candle out of the mold. If the temperature is too low, the candle will be too porous. It is impossible to get ideal smooth candle out of the candle molds. The temperature for pouring paraffin into the mold depends on a paraffin grade and its melting temperature. If it is difficult to take the candle out of the mold, put the candle with the mold into a freezer for 20-30 minutes, and then take the candle out. It is also possible to heat the mold with a candle using a hair dryer, to help take the candle out. Before pouring, make sure that the hole for a wick is sealed in order to avoid the loss of the candle mass.

description:
Beeswax is the only naturally existing wax on earth and is a completely renewable resource.

The bright flame of a beeswax candle releases the scent of honey and the nectar of flowers in a honeycomb. When a beeswax candle burns, it emits the same beautiful light spectrum as the sun, along with negative ions that clean the air of dust and fine particles. Negative ions are drawn to positive ions. Positive ions hold on to airborne things like dust, mold and odors; the negative ions latch on to the “contaminated” positive ions and weigh them down. This causes the contaminated positive ions to fall to the ground, cleaning and purifying the air.

A perfect example of this phenomenon is rainstorms. A rainstorm is a negative ionic event, which is why we say the air smells so fresh after a rainstorm. Our candles are dyed for a holiday atmosphere, and emit a subtle, gentle burn with a clean, stable flame once the wick reaches the wax. Our candles are clean and environmentally friendly.

description:
Our natural hand poured soy melts with essential oils add a luxury compared to no other. Our Wonderful Scents soy melts are made of 100% soy grown from sustainable farms by local US farmers.

Soy wax is derived from vegetables (soybeans) and paraffin wax is derived from petroleum (a refined gasoline product). We were looking for a natural, renewable resource that was sourced here in the United states for our Wonderful Scents candles and melts collections.

A FUN FACT
Here is an interesting/fun fact about the history of soy wax. Soy wax was invented by a group of Purdue college students in 1996. The students had to develop a birthday candle using a renewable resource.

description:
Havdalah 6" Braided Candle: Blue & White

A Havdalah candle is a braided candle with several wicks. A child or a woman often holds it while it is lit, then it is placed in a special candle holder that fits its thin, oblong shape.

The flame of the candle symbolizes the separation between the spiritual world and the material world. It also represents the first light of Creation, renewed energy for the upcoming week and new beginnings. After the blessing, traditionally people now raise their hands toward the flame and look at their fingernails, which reflect the fires light. Why? One explanation is simply the pleasure we receive by watching the flames reflection dancing on our fingers. Another is that the light reflected by our nails and the shadows cast by our fingers onto our palms represent the separation between light and darkness.

Havdalah is a ritual that takes place at the end of Shabbat. Just as candles are lit to welcome Shabbat on Friday evenings, Havdalah (Hebrew for separation) marks the end of Shabbat and separates it from regular weekdays. We know that Shabbat has ended and it is time for Havdalah when three stars appear in the night sky.

Root stellt ihre eigenen naturreinen Baumwolldochte her und testet täglich 1.000 Kerzen, um Duftwerf, Emissionen, Ruß, Flammenstärke, Stabilität, Lebensdauer, Welling, Tropfen und Brenndauer zu überprüfen. Eine strenge Farbabstimmung wird täglich durchgeführt, um eine gleichbleibende Qualität von Charge zu Charge zu Charge zu gewährleisten. Root hat die althergebrachten Methoden der handgefertigten Kerzenherstellung des frühen 20. Jahrhunderts mit Automatisierungstechnologien des 21. Jahrhunderts kombiniert, um eine bekannte Tradition und einen guten Ruf fortzusetzen. Jede Wurzelkerze wird in den USA hergestellt, auf dem gleichen Grundstück Amos Ives Root, vor über 100 Jahren gekauft. Die Ergebnisse sind pur und einfach: Wurzelkerzen sind sehr geschätzt für komplexe Bouquets mit subtilen Düften und raffinierten Farbpaletten. Heute setzt Root Kerzen traditionelle Standards der hervorragenden Kerzen-Handwerkskunst fort, während sie lebendige neue Texturen, brillante neue Farben, komplexe und faszinierende neue Düfte und innovative, moderne Designs in ihren Kollektionen einführen.

الجذور - أفضل الشموع في أمريكا، صنع في أمريكا. عمود غير معطر بقطر 7.62 سم مزين بمظلة فنية من الأغصان الشبيهة بالشجرة في الأعلى مع لحاء ناعم على جذع الشمعة. تتوفر هذه الشموع الغنية بشمع العسل بارتفاع 7.62 سم أو 15.24 سم أو 22.86 سم وتحرق 16 ساعة / بوصة. روت كاندل هي شركة أمريكية أيقونية تتتبع خطها مرة أخرى إلى عام 1869 عندما افتتح المؤسس آموس إيفز أبوابه لأول مرة للعمل في ميدينا، أوهايو. منذ ذلك الحين، ابتكرت 5 أجيال من صانعي الشموع من روت أفضل الشموع في أمريكا. باستخدام مواد طبيعية بالكامل للنقاء والتوازن، شموع الجذور تغري حواسك، وتعزز مساحة معيشتك وتهدئ روحك. تُصنع الشموع وفقًا لجميع معايير السلامة الخاصة بالجمعية الأمريكية لاختبار المواد. تصنع الجذور فتائل القطن الطبيعية بالكامل الخاصة بها وتختبر الحروق 1000 شمعة كل يوم للتحقق من رمي العطر والانبعاثات والسخام وقوة اللهب والاستقرار والحياة المفيدة والرفاهية والتقطير ووقت الاحتراق. يتم مطابقة الألوان الحادة يوميًا لضمان جودة ثابتة من الدفعة إلى الدفع. جمعت الجذور بين الأساليب المشهورة في أوائل القرن العشرين لصناعة الشموع يدويًا، مع تقنيات أتمتة القرن الحادي والعشرين لمواصلة التقاليد والسمعة المشهورة. كل شمعة جذور مصنوعة في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية، على نفس الدفعة من الأرض وجذور أموس أيفز، تم شراؤها منذ أكثر من 100 عام. النتائج نقية وبسيطة: شموع الجذور تحظى بشعبية كبيرة مع الباقات المعقدة من العطور الرقيقة ولوحات الألوان المتطورة. واليوم، تواصل شموع روت المعايير التقليدية لصناعة الشموع الفائقة مع تقديم تركيبات جديدة نابضة بالحياة، وألوان جديدة رائعة، وعطور جديدة معقدة ومثيرة للاهتمام، وتصميمات مبتكرة وحديثة لمجموعاتها.

A raiz fabrica seus próprios pavios de algodão totalmente naturais e testam queima 1.000 velas todos os dias para verificar o arremesso de fragrância, emissões, fuligem, força de chama, estabilidade, vida útil, gotejamento e tempo de queima. A correspondência de cores estranha é feita diariamente para garantir qualidade consistente de lote a lote. A raiz combinou os métodos honrados da fabricação de velas do início do século 20, com tecnologias de automação do século 21 para continuar uma renomada tradição e reputação. Hoje, as velas de raiz continuam os padrões tradicionais de artesanato superior de velas enquanto introduzem novas texturas vibrantes, novas cores brilhantes, fragrâncias complexas e intrigantes e designs inovadores e modernos para suas coleções.

根 - 美国最好的蜡烛,美国制造。 无香型 7.62 厘米直径支柱,顶部装饰有树枝状艺术蓬顶,结合蜡烛树干上的光滑风化树皮。 这些蜂蜡浓缩蜡烛有 3 英寸(约 7.6 厘米)、6 英寸(约 15.2 厘米)或 9 英寸(约 22.9 厘米)高度可供选择,燃烧 16 小时/英寸。 Root Candles 是一家标志性的美国公司,它追溯到 1869 年,当创始人 Amos Ives Root 首次在俄亥俄州麦地那开门业务大门。 此后,5 代根蜡烛制造商已经创造了美国最好的蜡烛。 根蜡烛采用纯天然材料打造纯净和平衡,根蜡烛诱惑您的感官,增强您的生活空间,舒缓您的灵魂。 蜡烛按照所有 ASTM (安全)标准制造。 根部制造自己的天然棉芯,每天测试燃烧 1000 支蜡烛,以检查香味投掷、排放、烟灰、火焰强度、稳定性、使用寿命、滴落和燃烧时间。 每天进行严格的颜色匹配,以确保从批次到批次的质量一致。 Root 结合了 20 世纪早期手工蜡烛制作方法和 21 世纪自动化技术延续了著名的传统和声誉。 每根根蜡烛都是在美国制造,在 100 多年前购买的土地 Amos Ives Root。 结果是纯净而简单:根蜡烛因其复杂的香味和精致的调色剂而备受推崇。 如今,根蜡烛继续遵循传统标准的优质蜡烛工艺,同时为其收藏品引入充满活力的新质地、绚丽的色彩、复杂和有趣的新香料以及创新现代设计。

根 - 美國最好的蠟燭,美國製造。 直徑 3 英吋(約 7.62 公分)的柱子裝飾著像樹木一樣的藝術傘冠,以及蠟燭箱上的光滑風化樹皮。 這些蜂蠟濃縮蠟燭有 7.6 公分、15.2 公分或 22.8 公分高度可供選擇,燃燒 16 小時/英吋。 Root Candles 是一家標誌性的美國公司,追溯到1869 年,當創始人 Amos Ives Root 在俄亥俄州麥地那首次開設商業大門時。 從那之後,5 代 Root 蠟燭製造商創造了美國最好的蠟燭。 Root 蠟燭採用全天然材料,實現純淨和平衡,誘惑您的感官,增強您的生活空間,並舒緩您的靈魂。 蠟燭是根據所有 ASTM (安全) 標準製造。 Root 生產自己的全天然棉芯,每天測試燃燒 1,000 根蠟燭,以檢查香味拋出、排放、煤煙、火焰強度、穩定性、使用壽命、健康、滴滴和燃燒時間。 每天都會對顏色進行嚴格匹配,以確保從批次到批次都始終如一。 Root 結合了 20 世紀初的手工蠟燭製作方法和 21 世紀自動化技術,延續了著名的傳統和聲譽。 每根根蠟燭都是美國製造,在 Amos Ives Root 的同一塊土地上,購買超過 100 年。 結果純淨且簡單:根蠟燭因其複雜的花束精緻香味和精緻調色盤而備受讚賞。 今天,Root 蠟燭延續了傳統上卓越的蠟燭工藝標準,同時為其收藏引入了充滿活力的新紋理、明亮的新顏色、複雜而有趣的新香味,以及創新、現代的設計。

뿌리 - 미국 최고의 양초, 미국에서 제작. 무향 7.6 cm (3 인치) 지름의 기둥은 나무 같은 가지를 장식하여 촛불 트렁크의 부드러운 풍화 껍질과 결합합니다. 이 밀랍이 풍부한 양초는 7.6 cm, 15.2 cm 또는 22.9 cm 높이로 제공되며 16 시간/인치로 연소됩니다. Root Candles는 설립자 Amos Ives Root가 오하이오 주 메디나에서 사업을 위해 문을 처음 열었을 때 1869년까지 계보를 추적하는 상징적인 미국 회사입니다. 그 이후로 5세대의 루트 캔들 메이커는 미국 최고의 캔들을 만들었습니다. 순도와 균형을 위해 모든 천연 재료를 사용하여 뿌리 양초는 감각을 유혹하고 생활 공간을 향상시키고 영혼을 진정시킵니다. 양초는 모든 ASTM (안전) 표준에 따라 제조됩니다. Root는 자체 천연 면화 심지와 테스트로 매일 1,000개의 양초를 태우므로 향수, 배출량, 그을음, 화염 강도, 안정성, 유효 수명, 웰빙, 물방울 및 연소 시간을 확인합니다. 엄격한 색상 일치는 배치에서 배치까지 일관된 품질을 보장하기 위해 매일 수행됩니다. Root는 20세기 초반 수제 양초 제작 방법과 21세기 자동화 기술을 결합하여 유명한 전통과 명성을 이어가고 있습니다. 모든 뿌리 양초는 100년 전에 구입한 Amos Ives Root의 땅과 동일한 플롯에서 미국에서 만들어집니다. 결과는 순수하고 간단합니다: 뿌리 양초는 미묘한 향기와 정교한 컬러 팔레트의 복잡한 부케로 높은 평가를 받고 있습니다. 오늘날, 루트 캔들은 탁월한 캔들 장인 정신의 전통적인 표준을 이어가고 있으며, 생생한 새로운 텍스처, 화려한 새로운 색상, 복잡하고 흥미로운 새로운 향수, 혁신적이고 현대적인 디자인을 컬렉션에 도입합니다.

شمعة زجاجية مصنوعة في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية مملوءة بمزيج من شمع العسل الطبيعي بالكامل معطر بالزيوت العطرية النقية. شمعة ليجاسي باي روت تدمج بين جمال الوعاء الزجاجي الرقيق ومجموعة متنوعة من العطور الغنية والراقية. وقت الاحتراق: حتى 70 ساعة. متوفرة بمقاسين، هذه الشموع الرائعة مزودة بغطاء معدني برونزي مزخرف. شموع روت هي شركة أمريكية أيقونية تتتبع خطها مرة أخرى إلى عام 1869 عندما افتتح المؤسس آموس إيفز أبوابه لأول مرة للعمل في ميدينا، أوهايو. منذ ذلك الحين، ابتكرت 5 أجيال من صانعي الشموع من روت أفضل الشموع في أمريكا. باستخدام مواد طبيعية بالكامل للنقاء والتوازن، شموع الجذور تغري حواسك، وتعزز مساحة معيشتك وتهدئ روحك. تُصنع الشموع وفقًا لجميع معايير السلامة الخاصة بالجمعية الأمريكية لاختبار المواد. تصنع الجذور فتائل القطن الطبيعية بالكامل الخاصة بها واختبار الحروق 1000 شمعة كل يوم للتحقق من رمي العطر والانبعاثات والسخام وقوة اللهب والاستقرار والحياة المفيدة والرفاهية والتقطير ووقت الاحتراق. يتم مطابقة الألوان الحادة يوميًا لضمان جودة ثابتة من الدفعة إلى الدفع. جمعت الجذور بين الأساليب المشهورة في أوائل القرن العشرين لصناعة الشموع يدويًا، مع تقنيات أتمتة القرن الحادي والعشرين لمواصلة التقاليد والسمعة المشهورة. كل شمعة جذور مصنوعة في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية، على نفس الدفعة من الأرض وجذور أموس أيفز، تم شراؤها منذ أكثر من 100 عام. النتائج نقية وبسيطة: شموع الجذور تحظى بشعبية كبيرة مع الباقات المعقدة من العطور الرقيقة ولوحات الألوان المتطورة. واليوم، تواصل شموع روت المعايير التقليدية لصناعة الشموع الفائقة مع تقديم تركيبات جديدة نابضة بالحياة، وألوان جديدة رائعة، وعطور جديدة معقدة ومثيرة للاهتمام، وتصميمات مبتكرة وحديثة لمجموعاتها.

A vela de vidro feita nos EUA é preenchida com uma mistura de cera de abelha totalmente natural perfumada com óleos essenciais puros. A vela de Veriglass da Legacy da Root combina a beleza de um recipiente de vidro delicado e uma variedade de fragrâncias ricas e sofisticadas. Tempo de queima: até 70 horas. Disponível em dois tamanhos, estas velas requintadas são cobertas com uma tampa de metal bronze enfeitada. Root Candle é uma empresa americana icônica que traça sua linhagem de volta a 1869 quando o fundador Amos Ives Root abriu suas portas pela primeira vez para negócios em Medina, Ohio. Desde então, 5 gerações de castiçais raiz criaram as melhores velas dos EUA. Usando materiais naturais para pureza e equilíbrio, as velas de raiz seduzem seus sentidos, melhoram o seu espaço e acalmam sua alma. As velas são fabricadas de acordo com todas as normas ASTM (segurança). A raiz fabrica seus próprios pavios de algodão totalmente naturais e testam queimaduras 1.000 velas todos os dias para verificar o arremesso de fragrância, emissões, fuligem, força de chama, estabilidade, vida útil, gotejamento e tempo de queima. A correspondência de cores estranha é feita diariamente para garantir qualidade consistente de lote a lote. A raiz combinou os métodos honrados da fabricação de velas do início do século 20, com tecnologias de automação do século 21 para continuar uma renomada tradição e reputação. Cada vela de raiz é feita nos EUA, no mesmo lote de terra Amos Ives Root, comprada há mais de 100 anos. Os resultados são puros e simples: as velas de raiz são altamente consideradas por buquês complexos de fragrâncias sutis e paletas de cores sofisticadas. Hoje, as velas de raiz continuam os padrões tradicionais de artesanato superior de velas enquanto introduzem novas texturas vibrantes, novas cores brilhantes, fragrâncias complexas e intrigantes e designs inovadores e modernos para suas coleções.

美國製造的玻璃蠟燭充滿純天然蜂蠟混合蠟燭,並以純精油製成。 LEGACY by Root's Veriglass 蠟燭結合了精緻玻璃容器和豐富、精緻的香味。 燃燒時間:長達 70 小時。 這些精緻的蠟燭有兩種尺寸可供選擇,上面有裝飾青銅金屬蓋。 根蠟燭是一家標誌性的美國公司,追溯其歷史,追溯到 1869 年,當創始人 Amos Ives Root 在俄亥俄州麥地那首次開門商業大門。 從那之後,5 代 Root 蠟燭製造商創造了美國最好的蠟燭。 Root 蠟燭採用全天然材料,實現純淨和平衡,誘惑您的感官,增強您的生活空間,並舒緩您的靈魂。 蠟燭是根據所有 ASTM (安全) 標準製造。 Root 生產自己的全天然棉芯,每天試驗 1,000 支蠟燭,以檢查香味拋出、排放、煤煙、火焰強度、穩定性、使用壽命、健康、滴滴和燃燒時間。 每天都會對顏色進行嚴格匹配,以確保從批次到批次都始終如一。 Root 結合了 20 世紀初的手工蠟燭製作方法和 21 世紀自動化技術,延續了著名的傳統和聲譽。 每根根蠟燭都是美國製造,在 Amos Ives Root 的同一塊土地上,購買超過 100 年。 結果純淨且簡單:根蠟燭因其複雜的花束精緻香味和精緻調色盤而備受讚賞。 今天,Root 蠟燭延續了傳統上卓越的蠟燭工藝標準,同時為其收藏引入了充滿活力的新紋理、明亮的新顏色、複雜而有趣的新香味,以及創新、現代的設計。

미국에서 제작된 유리 캔들은 순수 에센셜 오일 향이 나는 천연 밀랍 혼합 양초로 채워져 있습니다. LEGACY by Root의 Veriglass 캔들은 섬세한 유리 용기의 아름다움과 풍부하고 정교한 향기를 결합합니다. 연소 시간: 최대 70시간. 두 가지 크기로 제공되는 이 정교한 양초는 장식된 청동 금속 뚜껑으로 장식되어 있습니다. 루트 캔들은 설립자 Amos Ives Root가 오하이오 주 메디나에서 사업을 위해 문을 처음 열었을 때 1869년까지 계보를 추적하는 상징적인 미국 회사입니다. 그 이후로 5세대의 루트 캔들 메이커는 미국 최고의 캔들을 만들었습니다. 순도와 균형을 위해 모든 천연 재료를 사용하여 뿌리 양초는 감각을 유혹하고 생활 공간을 향상시키고 영혼을 진정시킵니다. 양초는 모든 ASTM (안전) 표준에 따라 제조됩니다. Root는 자신만의 천연 면화 심지와 테스트 연소를 제조하여 향수, 배출량, 그을음, 화염 강도, 안정성, 유효 수명, 웰링, 물방울 및 연소 시간을 확인합니다. 엄격한 색상 일치는 배치에서 배치까지 일관된 품질을 보장하기 위해 매일 수행됩니다. Root는 20세기 초반 수제 양초 제작 방법과 21세기 자동화 기술을 결합하여 유명한 전통과 명성을 이어가고 있습니다. 모든 뿌리 양초는 100년 전에 구입한 Amos Ives Root의 땅과 동일한 플롯에서 미국에서 만들어집니다. 결과는 순수하고 간단합니다: 뿌리 양초는 미묘한 향기와 정교한 컬러 팔레트의 복잡한 부케로 높은 평가를 받고 있습니다. 오늘날, 루트 캔들은 탁월한 캔들 장인 정신의 전통적인 표준을 이어가고 있으며, 생생한 새로운 텍스처, 화려한 새로운 색상, 복잡하고 흥미로운 새로운 향수, 혁신적이고 현대적인 디자인을 컬렉션에 도입합니다.

description:
The Sanari Candle Difference

Sanari Candle uses 100% Plant Based Technology to bring forward the true essence of each of our blended fragrances. Plant based candles are drawn from our earth and give back to our earth and you. Our essential oil candles emit the true essence of each of our blended fragrances. Made only with ingredients from organic farms, our coconut wax candles are a true life force. We make our eco-friendly candles in California, USA.

Organic Coconut Wax Candles

Coconut wax is made out of raw and natural product - the coconut. The process involves gathering the coconut meat and cold pressing its oil. Using the hydrogenation process, coconut oil is then transformed into wax. Coconut wax candles burn a lot cleaner and cooler and perfectly complement many kinds of essential oils. Coconut is organic, sustainable and eco-friendly. It is considered by many as the best wax used in candles.

GMO-Free Candles

The soy wax in our Eco-friendly candles is GMO-Free and no pesticides or herbicides are used at any stage in its cultivation. Our blends  are a renewable source and the wax is naturally bio-degradable. Our natural non-GMO candle is an eco-friendly product.

Our Quality Glass & Box

Each candle is individually hand poured in a recycle stem less wine glass to insure the highest quality and care. Glass is 100% recyclable and can be recycled endlessly without loss in quality or purity. Glass with virtually no chemical interaction ensures that our plant based candles contained in our glass jars maintain their strength and aroma. Our box is made with tree free paper (recycled paper) and printed with soy ink.

Beeswax is the only naturally existing wax on earth and is a completely renewable resource.

The bright flame of a beeswax candle releases the scent of honey and the nectar of flowers in a honeycomb. When a beeswax candle burns, it emits the same beautiful light spectrum as the sun, along with negative ions that clean the air of dust and fine particles. Negative ions are drawn to positive ions. Positive ions hold on to airborne things like dust, mold and odors; the negative ions latch on to the “contaminated” positive ions and weigh them down. This causes the contaminated positive ions to fall to the ground, cleaning and purifying the air.

A perfect example of this phenomenon is rainstorms. A rainstorm is a negative ionic event, which is why we say the air smells so fresh after a rainstorm. THE FOUNDERS

At Mer|Sea, we think life should be simple…like life at the beach. We try to reflect this attitude where utility, tranquility and simplicity reign supreme.


We are so lucky because we get to focus on the mindset of traveling and all the wonder that it brings. To us, physical and mental travel are equally important and can bring just as much pleasure. Sea you soon!


ABOUT OUR PRODUCTS

We begin and end with simplicity. Trusting our own instincts, we only make what we would give to our dearest friend.


Mindful products and minimal packaging are central to our development process. Our artisan soy wax blend candles are hand-poured in the USA using fresh fragrances and packaged in beautiful canvas bags. Our palette is sea-salt bleached hues of white, grey, and blue mixed with little flashes of silver and is a fusion of all the colors found in the sea. WHY WE CHOOSE SOY
Soy wax is derived from vegetables (soybeans) and paraffin wax is derived from petroleum (a refined gasoline product). We were looking for a natural, renewable resource that was sourced here in the United states for our Wonderful Scents candle collection.

A FUN FACT
Here is an interesting/fun fact about the history of soy wax. Soy wax was invented by a group of Purdue college students in 1996. The students had to develop a birthday candle using a renewable resource.

WOOD WICKS

description: Hamsa Hand Blessing in Off White Hand Made Art Design Made By ''NURIT'' Art in Ceramics Nurit Teva (1951), a fourth generation in Israel, was born in "Neve Tzedek", one of the oldest and most picturesque neighborhoods in Tel Aviv. Nurit, who studied art for four years in Wizo France High School, has been creating authentic art in ceramics for 30 years. . She is married to Moshe, who served in the Professional Army and who is working at present as the marketing director of the studio. The couple have three children. . Thirty years ago, Nurit started working in "Williams House", a studio located in an old house in a wadi near the town of Eilat, where she specialized in creating wall decorations made of natural clay from the copper mines in Timnah. . In the eighties, Nurit started creating authentic ceramic Hamssahs (lucky talisman), and for a long period of time designed and created Hamssahs for the "Maskit" chain of galleries which specialized in original Israeli art. . Nurit works and creates in a peaceful, rural atmosphere in her studio in Moshav Ben-Shemen, which is on the ancient Roman road to Jerusalem. Her artistic work is influenced by oriental motifs which are typical of Mediterranean countries, Morocco and Spain. . Nurit works in a unique style which she herself developed; It combines smooth surfaces with rough ones (created with a knife), and natural colors (Angove) with glaze coating. This combination creates an interesting contrast. . Her designs are originally hers, and her work is completely hand-made, fired in a kiln in very high temperatures (1100 degrees Celsius). . In addition to creating Hamssahs, Nurit designs and creates other items such as: clocks, Mezuzah houses, owls, trays, candle holders and much more. . Her collection constantly changes. description:
We offer the engineered plastic candle molds. They are suitable for filling with wax, paraffin and other bases. The material is very much resistant to high and low temperatures (up to 85-90°С / 185-194 °F), that’s why the candle molds do not crack or break down in service. Plastic can be in contact with paraffin.

The molds are divided into a body and a lid to take a candle out comfortably. We recommend greasing the candle mold with silicone or oil before filling it with wax, in order to be able to take the candle out more easily. There is a hole in the center of the lid to pull a wick through. Use boiled water to clean the carved candle mold after taking the candle out. Make sure the candle mold is properly cleaned and free of wax before reusing it. If the mold is not completely cleaned, this might create difficulties for extracting the candle you are going to make next. Follow these instructions to avoid issues with pouring the candles.

The lower the temperature, the higher the chances of candle’s surface to get matte are. The higher the temperature of the filling, the smoother the surface will get. But it is necessary to remember that the higher temperature of paraffin, the more difficult it will be to take candle out of the mold. If the temperature is too low, the candle will be too porous. It is impossible to get ideal smooth candle out of the candle molds. The temperature for pouring paraffin into the mold depends on a paraffin grade and its melting temperature. If it is difficult to take the candle out of the mold, put the candle with the mold into a freezer for 20-30 minutes, and then take the candle out. It is also possible to heat the mold with a candle using a hair dryer, to help take the candle out. Before pouring, make sure that the hole for a wick is sealed in order to avoid the loss of the candle mass.

When a beeswax candle burns, it emits the same beautiful light spectrum as the sun, along with negative ions that clean the air of dust and fine particles. Negative ions are drawn to positive ions. Positive ions hold on to airborne things like dust, mold and odors; the negative ions latch on to the “contaminated” positive ions and weigh them down. This causes the contaminated positive ions to fall to the ground, cleaning and purifying the air.

A perfect example of this phenomenon is rainstorms. A rainstorm is a negative ionic event, which is why we say the air smells so fresh after a rainstorm. Our candles are dyed for a holiday atmosphere, and emit a subtle, gentle burn with a clean, stable flame once the wick reaches the wax. Our candles are clean and environmentally friendly.

Why Soy?

- Soy wax is 100% natural & renewable.

- Soy candles are better for the environment and your health: they are non-toxic and burn cleaner than paraffin wax. Soy produces as much as 90% less soot than paraffin wax. - Soy helps U.S. farmers by creating important economic growth for the agricultural sector.

description:
Wooly Beast Soy Candle Collection
Wooly beast artisan candles are handmade & hand poured in Portland, OR in small batches. We use Nitro Musk & Phthalate Free essential oils and all natural, sustainable & biodegradable materials that are Palm Oil Free and Dye Free. Our candles are made with 100% soy wax grown in the USA and 100% eco cotton wick to ensure a quality burn time.

Why Soy?

- Soy wax is 100% natural & renewable.

- Soy candles are better for the environment and your health: they are non-toxic and burn cleaner than paraffin wax. Soy produces as much as 90% less soot than paraffin wax. Soot can blacken walls, ceilings, and furniture, contaminate ventilation ductwork, and most importantly, add toxic carcinogens into the air you breathe.

- Soy candles burn slower than paraffin wax candles, making them last significantly longer.

- Soy helps U.S. farmers by creating important economic growth for the agricultural sector.

NOTE: The natural color from the oils may change the color of the wax. Many candles with a higher vanilla content will change the soy wax yellow or brown when sunlight hits them.

Never leave a candle burning unattended. Always trim candle wick 1/4” before each use.

Eco Home + Body
Wooly Beast is a unique collection of all natural, eco-friendly home and body products. Created in our Portland, Oregon home studio, it began with inspiration from the many places we have lived and traveled, with a sharp focus on sustainable, eco-friendly, vegan and non-toxic materials. We use a blend of fine fragrances and essential oils that are free of harmful chemicals and animal testing. We do not use any paraffin wax, palm oil, or beeswax in any of our products. Our scents are based on memories, journeys, food, and all the special things that we would want to bring into our home to make it a cozier, inviting space.

We love what we make, and we hope you love it as well.

Sincerely,
Trevor & Skylar

title: DANFORTH - Middlebury Candlestick - 4 5/8 Inch - Pewter - Handcrafted - Made in USA
description: DANFORTH PEWTER ARTISAN MADE MIDDLEBURY CANDLESTICK. Traditionally styled, the classic form of this diminutive turned candlestick will add elegance to your decorative display. Named after the historic Vermon town that is the home of Danforth Pewter, the Middlebury measures 4-5/8" high and holds a half-inch taper or "half-taper." The smooth and lustrous finish complements any décor beautifully. Made of the finest quality lead-free pewter, each candlestick is individually hand crafted and signed, and bears the Danforth lion touchmark. Comes in an imprinted flannel pouch with care and use card. Makes wonderful gift destined to become a treasured family heirloom. About pewter . . . Although pewter has always been a traditional and elegant choice, for many pewter is a preferred choice today over silver - more economical, every bit as beautiful, and easier to care for, so more appropriate to today's fast-paced lifestyle! Pewter does not tarnish the way silver and copper tarnish. Like all metals, pewter does oxidize when exposed to air. But, unlike other metals, pewter oxidizes very slowly and evenly. This means your pewter gradually develops the soft warm patina that adds so much to its lasting charm. Want your pewter to grow more beautiful with age? description:
Store Indya is a travel quest to unravel the forgotten hand crafted skills of India…

Store Indya was something that was created as a result of family trips we took across India. While travelling, we not only saw different cultures in different parts of India, but we also realized each corner of India has its own secret. They all have their own unique art forms that’s known to only a very few in India, and almost unknown to the rest of the world. We discovered that these age-old glorious skills are getting suppressed. The artisans that we work with are trying to continue the dying legacy of their artwork. Each artwork handcrafted by them is an end product of their hard and meticulous work.

Store Indya wants to revive these art forms and at the same time empower these skilled artists. We want to present different art forms and create a whole new product by itself that has never been created before.

Overall, these products not only stand for aesthetics and traditions, but the designs on it also represent various socio-cultural issues that we want to talk about with the world and even encourage others to talk about it by gifting these handicrafts to one another. We want our products to not just sit quietly, looking pretty in a corner of your home, but in fact speak your mind. We at Store Indya believe in – “Design to empower.”

As happy as a lark, this delicious scent of cupboard and of swilled down tile floors, recall the washing days of George Sand’s heroes and the Parisian laundry maids. Between stacks of embroidered linen sheets on a lady’s festooned bed, lavender and orange diffuse a smell of lightness and neatness.

A "lavandière", or laundress, was a woman who washed linens by hand, in a stream or at a wash house. The laundry was thrown into the water, rubbed with ash, rinsed, twisted and folded repeatedly. It was then beaten with a wooden instrument to wring out as much water as possible. It was then placed in a basket and taken somewhere to dry. In Paris, members of the laundress guild worked in dozens of wash houses, called “wash-sheds”, that were moored in the Canal St. Martin. Despite the hard labour, the laundresses, or washer-maids, were joyful, chattering and teasing amongst themselves.

description:
Wooly Beast Soy Candle Collection
Wooly beast artisan candles are handmade & hand poured in Portland, OR in small batches. We use Nitro Musk & Phthalate Free essential oils and all natural, sustainable & biodegradable materials that are Palm Oil Free and Dye Free. Our candles are made with 100% soy wax grown in the USA and 100% eco cotton wick to ensure a quality burn time.

Why Soy?

- Soy wax is 100% natural & renewable.

- Soy candles are better for the environment and your health: they are non-toxic and burn cleaner than paraffin wax. Soy produces as much as 90% less soot than paraffin wax. Soot can blacken walls, ceilings, and furniture, contaminate ventilation ductwork, and most importantly, add toxic carcinogens into the air you breathe.

- Soy candles burn slower than paraffin wax candles, making them last significantly longer.

- Soy helps U.S. farmers by creating important economic growth for the agricultural sector.

NOTE: The natural color from the oils may change the color of the wax. Many candles with a higher vanilla content will change the soy wax yellow or brown when sunlight hits them.

Never leave a candle burning unattended. Always trim candle wick 1/4” before each use.

Eco Home + Body
Wooly Beast is a unique collection of all natural, eco-friendly home and body products. Created in our Portland, Oregon home studio, it began with inspiration from the many places we have lived and traveled, with a sharp focus on sustainable, eco-friendly, vegan and non-toxic materials. We use a blend of fine fragrances and essential oils that are free of harmful chemicals and animal testing. We do not use any paraffin wax, palm oil, or beeswax in any of our products. Our scents are based on memories, journeys, food, and all the special things that we would want to bring into our home to make it a cozier, inviting space.

We love what we make, and we hope you love it as well.

Sincerely,
Trevor & Skylar

Havdalah 6" Braided Candle: Blue & White

A Havdalah candle is a braided candle with several wicks. A child or a woman often holds it while it is lit, then it is placed in a special candle holder that fits its thin, oblong shape.

The flame of the candle symbolizes the separation between the spiritual world and the material world. It also represents the first light of Creation, renewed energy for the upcoming week and new beginnings. After the blessing, traditionally people now raise their hands toward the flame and look at their fingernails, which reflect the fires light. Why? One explanation is simply the pleasure we receive by watching the flames reflection dancing on our fingers. Another is that the light reflected by our nails and the shadows cast by our fingers onto our palms represent the separation between light and darkness.

Havdalah is a ritual that takes place at the end of Shabbat. Just as candles are lit to welcome Shabbat on Friday evenings, Havdalah (Hebrew for separation) marks the end of Shabbat and separates it from regular weekdays. We know that Shabbat has ended and it is time for Havdalah when three stars appear in the night sky.

Organic Coconut Wax Candles

Coconut wax is made out of raw and natural product - the coconut. The process involves gathering the coconut meat and cold pressing its oil. Coconut is organic, sustainable and eco-friendly. It is considered by many as the best wax used in candles.

GMO-Free Candles

Always light your candle for 3 hours the first time to create an even burning candle.

Wooly Beast Soy Candle Collection
Wooly beast artisan candles are handmade & hand poured in Portland, OR in small batches. We use Nitro Musk & Phthalate Free essential oils and all natural, sustainable & biodegradable materials that are Palm Oil Free and Dye Free. Our candles are made with 100% soy wax grown in the USA and 100% eco cotton wick to ensure a quality burn time.

Why Soy?

- Soy wax is 100% natural & renewable.

- Soy candles are better for the environment and your health: they are non-toxic and burn cleaner than paraffin wax. Soy produces as much as 90% less soot than paraffin wax. Soot can blacken walls, ceilings, and furniture, contaminate ventilation ductwork, and most importantly, add toxic carcinogens into the air you breathe.

- Soy candles burn slower than paraffin wax candles, making them last significantly longer.

- Soy helps U.S. farmers by creating important economic growth for the agricultural sector.

NOTE: The natural color from the oils may change the color of the wax. Many candles with a higher vanilla content will change the soy wax yellow or brown when sunlight hits them.

Never leave a candle burning unattended. Always trim candle wick 1/4” before each use.

Eco Home + Body
Wooly Beast is a unique collection of all natural, eco-friendly home and body products. Created in our Portland, Oregon home studio, it began with inspiration from the many places we have lived and traveled, with a sharp focus on sustainable, eco-friendly, vegan and non-toxic materials. We use a blend of fine fragrances and essential oils that are free of harmful chemicals and animal testing. We do not use any paraffin wax, palm oil, or beeswax in any of our products. Our scents are based on memories, journeys, food, and all the special things that we would want to bring into our home to make it a cozier, inviting space.

We love what we make, and we hope you love it as well.

Sincerely,

WHY WE CHOOSE SOY
Soy wax is derived from vegetables (soybeans) and paraffin wax is derived from petroleum (a refined gasoline product). We were looking for a natural, renewable resource that was sourced here in the United states for our Wonderful Scents candle collection.

A FUN FACT
Here is an interesting/fun fact about the history of soy wax. Soy wax was invented by a group of Purdue college students in 1996. The students had to develop a birthday candle using a renewable resource.

WOOD WICKS
Our wood wicks are not only unique, but are also made from lumber sourced from Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certified mills in the United States. The FSC is dedicated to promoting responsible forestry and ensures the mills are meeting the highest environmental and social standards.

description: The Advent wreath is the traditional centerpiece of the Christmas season. It symbolizes the passage of the four weeks of Advent in the liturgical calendar of the Western Church. Advent begins on the fourth Sunday before Christmas Day. On the First Sunday of Advent, a purple (or blue) candle is lit to celebrate Hope, the inspiring and uplifting hope that Christ among us represents. On the Second Sunday of Advent, another purple (or blue) candle is lit to celebrate Peace, both the Prince of Peace himself and the promise of peace on Earth. On the Third Sunday of Advent, a pink candle is lit to celebrate Joy, the joy the shepherds received at hearing the news of Christ's birth, or the joy that God brings into our lives. As the coming of Christ draws near, the final purple (or blue) candle is lit on the Fourth Sunday of Advent to celebrate Love, both God's boundless love for us and our love for one another. The bright light from the candles is an expression of the growing anticipation of the birth of Jesus Christ, who in Christian faith is seen as the Light of the World. Hanukkah is a Jewish holiday commemorating the rededication of the Holy Temple (the second Temple) in Jerusalem at the time of the Maccabean revolt against the Seleucid Empire. Hanukkah is observed for eight nights and days, starting on the 25th day of isle according to the Hebrew calendar, which may occur at any time from late November to late December in the Gregorian calendar. It is also known as the festival of lights and the feast of dedication. The festival is observed by the kindling of the lights of a unique candelabrum, the nine-branched menorah (also called a Chanukah/Hanukah), one additional light on each night of the holiday, progressing to eight on the final night. The typical menorah consists of eight branches with an additional visually distinct branch. The extra light, with which the others are lit, is called a Shamash (Hebrew: שמש‎‎, "attendant") and is given a distinct location, usually above or below the rest.[1] other Hanukkah festivities include playing deride and eating oil-based foods such as doughnuts and latkes.
